red_duration_max.description: Seconds Red Light lasts at level 1.

red_duration_min.description: Seconds Red Light lasts at max_level.

green_duration_max.description: Seconds Green Light lasts at level 1.

green_duration_min.description: Seconds Green Light lasts at max_level.

warning_pulse_max.description: Seconds each of a warning's three pulses lasts at level 1.

warning_pulse_min.description: Seconds each of a warning's three pulses lasts at max_level.

game_over_duration.description: Seconds Game Over lasts before returning to Ready.

green_still_timeout.description: Seconds a player may hold still during Green Light before the game is over.

level_up_duration.description: Seconds Level Up lasts before the next round's red warning.

max_level.description: Game Level whose round, once survived, wins; phase durations shorten toward it.

motion_smoothing.description: Smoothing factor (0 < alpha <= 1) for the motion signal. Lower rejects spikes more but reacts slower; 1.0 disables smoothing.

gravity_beta.description: Tracking rate (0 < beta <= 1) of the gravity estimate. Must stay below motion_smoothing, or real motion is absorbed into the gravity estimate before it registers.
